title: Deposit Deadline Bridge
summary: Keep deposit and final payment dates intact when a quote becomes an invoice.
user: An event, catering, or project business that quotes a deposit and final balance and needs those independently negotiated dates to survive conversion to an invoice.
smallest_useful_product: A local quote attachment that defines deposit/final milestones, emits calendar files and reminder emails, and exports two clear payment instructions for any accounting system.
success_measure: During a 60-day pilot, 90% of accepted quotes with deposits have both deadlines recorded and no deadline is retyped after invoice creation.
constraints: Never send payment reminders without user confirmation; store dates/time zones precisely; locale-specific invoice and late-fee rules remain user-configured.
